Walking alongside Mejiro McQueen, the 
challenge for the Twinkle Series had 
begun.

In order to become an Umamusume worthy of 
the prestigious "Mejiro" name, she set the 
goal of "conquering the Tenno Sho."

Aiming to run in the Tenno Sho, she first 
sets her sights on winning her upcoming 
debut race.
